comment: Relationship footprint (Account Planning, brief 5.1): which products each golden client holds or uses with SMBC APAC at every month-end from Apr-2023 to Sep-2026. Held products are deposit accounts (month-end balance), credit facilities (drawn and limit), live trade-finance instruments, cash-management structures (header or participant) and SCF programmes (anchor); flow products (trade, FX, payments) count as used when the client transacted in the trailing 12 months. Rows are dense per client x product from the month of first use, so lapsed products stay visible (is_active = false). Balances and limits are point-in-time and 12-month volumes are trailing windows: never sum them across months - take the latest month (or one month). Client- month attributes (products held, deposit-only, single-product lending, peer median) repeat on every product row of the client-month: count them on is_client_month_primary_row only. Grain: one row per golden client x product x month (dense from the first month of use to Sep-2026).
